112928.overview:
Avengers assemble! In 2013, developer ZVitor launched Marvel First Alliance, a beat 'em up created with the OpenBor engine and inspired by classics like Streets of Rage and Double Dragon. It features a Marvel dream team and includes simultaneous four-player action for friends to join in!

The Story begins with the threat of the malefic organization Hydra, choosing your hero from favorites such as Hulk, Captain America or Thor, among others. More superheroes are unlocked with the defeat of enemy bosses, including Wolverine, Storm, Spider-Man, Colossus, Iron Man, Nightcrawler, Cyclops and many more! Each character is not just aesthetically different and faithful to the comic sources; they also have different movement types, speed and special attacks. The traditional side-scrolling gameplay throws lots of enemies at the player until reaching the final boss of each level and the large and diverse cast offers some variety and replayability.

The game's long development shows in its attention to detail and became a stepping stone for the Brazilian developer, being among the first of many OpenBor releases. A follow-up to this game, Marvel First Alliance 2, was more of an update rather than a sequel, adding more characters, tweaks and fixes to the original.

142621.overview:
Marvel Infinity War is a fan-made game using the OpenBor engine. This beat 'em up hearkens back to the arcades of old, with 85 playable good guys and bad guys from the Marvel universe. Using a six-button control scheme, each character has a special move and an ultra move, along with special assist characters to summon during the heat of battle.

There are five different overarching teams of characters available, including the Avengers, X-Men, Cosmic, Street Level, and Villains. They each visit their own stages and battle different bosses.

142626.overview:
Mortal Kombat: Outworld Assassins is a 2D beat 'em up developed by Magggas and modded by Gurtag using the OpenBOR engine. It was originally released in 2010 and updated eight years later.

Play solo or co-op as Sub-Zero, Scorpion or Noob Saibot and fight off countless enemies from Mortal Kombat lore using a lethal array of attacks and special moves, complete with the blood and guts the franchise is known for. Gameplay is fast and the controls are tight, responsive and so satisfying to send limbs flying and finish off foes with a decapitation.

On March 21, 2018, Magggas released a widescreen version of the game that includes bug fixes and minor tweaks to the original, known as Mortal Kombat: Outworld Assassins XL.

176567.overview:
Red Skull and Hydra are trying to take over the world! Grab up to four players and team up as one of dozens of Marvel's most powerful superheroes to stop them, in Marvel First Alliance 2. 

This 16-bit beat 'em up was released in 2014 by ZVitor, a popular designer from Brazil who created the game using the OpenBor engine project. It features dozens of playable characters that are unlocked after each level in the Story mode. Finish the game and unlock numerous other modes, like a Spider-Man and Carnage scenario, X-Men and Apocalypse, or harder difficulties. The game plays like the traditional side-scrolling brawlers from the arcades with unique special abilities and power-ups, and adds some modern updates to the mix, like NPC-controlled heroes joining you during the fight and situation-specific characters available according to the story.

200650.overview: Mega man: War of the Past has the unique distinction of being the first fully completed Beats of Rage mod. Created by DCSteve in 2004, the mod displayed many features which would lead the way for even more enhancements to the original game module. The mod also influenced the further development of the Beats of Rage game engine, which eventually became OpenBoR.

201509.overview: Maximum Carnage Returns is an OpenBOR beat 'em up created by Silas Elrick Heat and Heat Games in 2017. This fan-made reboot of the 16-bit classic from 1994, Maximum Carnage, features three playable characters: Spider-Man, Deadpool and Venom.

202177.overview:
Mortal Kombat classic games, reimagined like a 16-bits beat 'em up. 

@ZVitor brings his touch to the Mortal Kombat franchise. Get busy with a big selection of warriors and all the blood spattering violence you'd expect.

217080.overview:
Thanos mounts the six Infinity Gems on his left glove to form the titular Infinity Gauntlet.
Each Gem grants its bearer complete mastery over one aspect of the universe: Time, Space, Mind, Soul, Reality, and Power. 
Now all-powerful and desperate to win the affections of Death, Thanos decides to offer the entity a gift of love by completing a task she had given him, erasing half the sentient life in the universe (including most of the X-Men, Daredevil, and the Fantastic Four), quite literally with a snap of his fingers. The surviving heroes on Earth band together guided by the newly-resurrected Adam Warlock to battle Thanos. 
In a bid to impress Death, Thanos allows the heroes a slight chance of winning. Can you save the universe?

219007.overview:
The story of this game takes place after Golden Axe 3 and before Golden Axe: Revenge of Death Adder.

Everyone is here! Dora, Trix, Tyris, Sara, Kain, and all the rest. Pick your favorite battle hardened hero and choose your path. Swap weapons on the fly for tons of combinations. Grab three of your friends and take on the hordes in an all out four player war!

Have Fun!

327353.overview:
It took a few hero movies for them to unite against a common threat in The Avengers. So it’s with perfect timing that Brazilian developer Zvitor launches Marvel First Alliance, an indie game created with the popular OpenBor engine. The game is a beat’em up inspired by the likes of Streets of Rage and Double Dragon and features a dream team that will certainly please any Marvel fan. But best of all, it features simultaneous four-player action!

This release features a Special Edition of Marvel First Aliance by Ripfire, which doesn't need the RAM saving version of DreamBoR (bye bye long loading times!)...

330427.overview: Maximum Carnage Returns is an excellent remake of/sequel to the classic Spiderman games, offering hours of quality traditional beat 'em up action completely for free.

425614.overview:
Remake of the famous and the mega-popular fighting game of all time, but done in the genre Beat 'em up. The game boasts proprietary graphics, new Persians and various special effects. Complexity hellish enough, but the developer has provided 90 continue, and Cheats. We're playing for the "good guys" who must defeat a gang 
of Shao Kahn ;-) The choice available to Scorpion, Sub-Zero, Liu Kang, Reydan, Jax, Milena and John Cage, you can change a fighter in the game, not necessarily pass the entire game, one fighter. Managing three-button: button combos, jump, special. The X-mas edition is only for Sega DreamCast.

451958.overview:
The ultimate battle is about to begin. The universe has chosen a new warrior to save the realm. She will be endowed with incredible strength and the power of each element, but even she can't do this alone. Fortunately, she won't have to. The best of the best are here to help. Chose a fighter from across the Mortal Kombat Universe, joined by Killer Instinct, Robocop, Batman, and many others.

Unleash an endless arsenal of techniques to bring down your enemies. When an opponent is at your mercy, finish him with one of several gruesome fatalities. Be warned, this gauntlet will test more than your might. Bring a keen mind to defeat the challenging traps and puzzles you'll face along the way.

    12 selectable characters
        Carolina
        Caorlina empowered as The Chosen One
        Liu Kang
        Raiden
        Kitana
        Tusk
        Jago
        Fulgore
        Orchid
        Midas
        Batman
        Robocop
    4 fatalities per character, plus a brutal No Mercy finisher
    Stage fatalities, Special Stage fatalities and Obstacle fatalities.
    Multiple paths.
    Collectable weapons, including knives, shotguns and spiked bats with their own finishing executions.


- More than 50 detailed levels.
- New Sahdows and effect for all levels.

- More balanced enemies and with Random AI,

453085.overview:
This amazingly ambitious project by MatMan is one part technical demo, one part choose your own adventure game, and one part proving ground for his then in production module making tool. Choose your available characters, difficulty, power-ups, NPC helpers, path and more, all in real time. Try out dozens of ways to punish the enemy (whoever that is).

The intent was a game easily added to and modified with new content by other creators. Unfortunately, MatMan vanished from the the internet in 2013 and abandoned all of his projects. Even so you'll find plenty to explore and lots of learning examples despite its age. Four player action and tons of options also make it a fun party game.

Note MixMasters has an unusual start up. On first run, only the hand is available for selection. You then use the hand to pick from characters you wish to load. You may then select these characters to play on subsequent runs. The download includes move lists and a complete manual.

453096.overview:
A storm has arrived throughout the land. Two of the most diabolical scientists have joined forces and are spreading terror all over the planet.
Dr. Robotnik and Dr. Wily are taking no prisoners and have created an army of robots.
With Wily's help, Robotnik can improve his creations and even rebuild his ultimate weapon, "The Death Egg". There are even two new robots that Wily and Robotnik designed together.
The only ones who stand in their way are Sonic, Mega Man, Knuckles, Proto Man, Bass, Shadow, Tails, Bunnie, Roll and Rouge.
Get ready for the greatest battle throughout Mega Man and Sonic history and the first time ever that these two worlds collide.

453107.overview: What if you could combine MegaMan with four player action and characters from franchises like My Little Pony, Shovel Knight, and... everyone else? You'd have an armada! Choose MegaMan or any of his eclectic allies for a few rounds of fun and gun action!

453244.overview:
Metal Gear Origin: Code Name: Solid Snake is one of the best games for OpenBoR that predates the first generation of games from this brand. It should be noted that it is more of a 2D shooter than a Beat 'em up. It will be quite difficult for you to fight and for that you will need to shoot a lot. 
 
Something that will really make you want to play is that the new difficulty is well above average and requires you to be a very good gamer. Additionally, the cheat menu is disabled and you will not be able to add additional credits. Fortunately, you can use the load game feature to reload your 5 credits.

Metal Gear Origin: Code Name: Solid Snake begins with the main character Solid Snake. After playing the game once, you will be able to unlock the full variant where the characters Golden Geese, Red Raptor, and an additional variant of the character Solid Snike are also added.

453274.overview:
Contains 3 Metal Slug games for OpenBor. 
Metal Slug: The Lost Missions (New)
Metal Slug: The new Rebellion Power (2.5)
Metal Slug 3X: Ultimate

Now features VS mode and more features to unlock!

453278.overview:
Enter a futuristic world of frantic action where chaos dominates! In Metal Slug Counter, you will control brave warriors equipped with powerful lightsabers, tasked with facing hordes of enemies. With a fluid and fast gameplay, similar to the classic Metal Slug series, players will not use firearms, but energy slides to cut off their opponents and deflect projectiles with millimeter accuracy.

Master devastating combos, divert attacks in real time, and utilize your skills to overcome epic challenges. Each phase is filled with challenging enemies, deadly traps, and colossal bosses, where only the most skilled warriors survive.

Prepare for an intense, action-packed experience where quick reflexes and strategic decisions will determine your destiny on the battlefield!

453284.overview:
With the wave of certifying video game cartridges and sealing them in acrylic boxes to inflate their prices, the retrogaming industry was collapsing.

A new company, called M.A. Games, led by Mr. Turkey, certified all copies of a game, and this caused an imbalance in Blast Processing and a portal opened in the sky, taking our friends from the Mega Drive Community, in addition to their subscribers to a world of pixels.

A very frequent subscriber who was also swallowed by the portal, receives the power of Blast Processing and has the mission to defeat Mr. Turkey and thus end the certification, bringing everyone back to the real world.

453517.overview:
I am releasing a beta of my free-fan game, Mega Man Power Adventure, a beat´ n up of Mega Man made in OpenBor.
Besides to shooting, the characters also beat the enemies with punches and kicks. As if it were an evolution of the idea of Megaman Power Battle/Fighter, which approached Megaman in the style of a fighting game. This, changes the gameplay to a beat´n up style.

Ra-Moon is back and kidnaps Dr. Willy from prison. At the same time, several robots are out of control and cause chaos throughout the city.

MegaMan, ProtoMan and Bass (and Duo, who returned from space) join forces to stop the chaos with other robot masters, to stop the threat of Ra-Moon and to save Dr. Willy's life in the process.
They will have help from some NPC´s throughout the 8 stages of the game, like FlipTop (Eddie), Beat, Metols of the Dr. Light, Bunby-Tanks, BombMan...

Nine Playable characters at moment with 6 palletes:
- MegaMan (or RockMan)
- ProtoMan (or Blues)
- GutsMan
- Bass (or Forte)
- HeatMan
- CutMan
- TomahawkMan
- Duo
- IceMan

The game has 3 modes for now:

1 - Story Mode:
The Main Mode of the game.

2 - Robot Master Arena Mode:
The robots are invited to participate in the new robot master tournament (the last one was in MegaMan6), by... King.
Fight All robots from Story Mode and King as last Boss.

3 - Moto-Jet Mode:
Play the two stages riding Moto-Jet in this game (based on Moto-Jets from MegaMan 5, Megaman X4, plus Special Shot and Defense, in this game)

456954.overview:
The game starts with 19 characters from Marvel's urban universe, in addition to the Fantastic Four and Captain America.
Another 12 characters are unlocked after the game is finished, including Spider-Man villains, Carnage himself and even Stan Lee.

Maximum Carnage for SNES and Sega Genesis is possibly the most faithful game to the comics. For those who don't know, one of Shirek's powers is Dark Empathy: She can bring out people's Dark Side. During the Maximum Carnage comics, she used this power to make the city go crazy, which is why in the game you face ordinary people on the streets. Which is good on one hand, but a bit annoying, because in the original game you face Carnage several times before the final battle, just like Shirek, so in this remake several changes were made, such as street enemies from Venom/Spider-Man: Separation Anxiety, Shield Agents instead of police officers, and in one of the battles you face in the original game once again all the bosses from the game in addition to civilians.

Another change is the cutting of cutscenes, because some didn't make sense, like Venom joining the team and Captain America as a sidekick, even though here they are available from the beginning of the game.

463012.overview:
Our most ambitious remake project! The closest thing to the original game and the furthest from Marvel Infinity War.
This project was truly a childhood dream of mine, and all the "What IF" questions in the trailer were questions I really imagined back then.

The game starts with only the characters from Marvel War of Gems and X-Men Mutant Apocalypse, and each time the game is finished a team will be unlocked, a total of 8 times will be necessary for a total of more than 40 characters.
Despite trying to be as faithful as possible, we still shortened some vertical levels to make the camera easier when 2 players are playing, not all walls are climbable, and I removed the physics of hitting your head on the ceiling because it introduced bugs that I wasn't willing to address now.

464944.overview:
The year is 1997 and our three heroes are back. Four years after the clash with Belger, Mayor Mike Haggar with Cody and Guy return to the streets to save Metro City and his residents from a new threat.

Mighty Final Fight Forever is a fanmade beat ’em up project following on from the original Mighty Final Fight game released by Capcom in 1993.

* A whole new story
* Original characters (redesigned with new moves)
* Color palettes collected from other final fight games
* New playable characters
* Original enemies (redesigned with new moves)
* New enemies
* Original levels (completely remaked)
* Levels from other Final Fight games (completely remaked)
* Completely new levels
* Remaked original soundtrack and some new tracks
* New weapons and special attacks
* Several ways to go through and finish the game
* 2 players mode
* Retro mode
* Arena mode
